General 22,461,809 is in detail[] (p14). The Debt Service Fund already has its own schedule in detail[] (p16, 'Budget and Actual (Budgetary Basis)'), which prints Proceeds from bond issuance 46,866,242 and Transfers from other funds 2,638,758 instead (46,866,242 + 2,638,758 = 49,505,000; the statement prints Transfers, net (27,897,181) for the same fund) - a budgetary-basis difference of 2,638,758; adding the statement's 49,505,000 would double count the schedule line. No printed proceeds line is missing; no fix.
